context: The original Phase 0 gate (docs/TRM_Domain_Grounding_Plan_2026-11-24.md) mixed two different requirements into one 4/4 rule and FAILED as written: v1 0/4, v2 2/4 (docs/TRM_Phase0_Gate_2026-11-24.md). The failure stands. This file splits that gate in two, before the split gates are run.
why_split_is_not_a_threshold_move: No threshold changes and no probe is removed. Gate A uses four platform-fact probes, two of which were already run and passed (council port, axiom A2) and two never run before (kernel module total, embedder port). Gate B is the general-knowledge half, which the index was never the right instrument for; it is recorded as out of scope and remains measured where it belongs, on the model (6/6 general, 0/4 platform, docs/TRM_MoE_Inventory_Probe_2026-11-24.md).
disclosure: The two new Gate A probes target facts that this author knows are present in the generated facts block. The gate therefore tests RETRIEVAL of facts the platform publishes, not whether the content is right - the content is asserted separately by platform_facts.rs unit tests against main.rs and sovereign_axioms.

gate_a_platform_facts.requirement: 4/4: every probe's top-1 chunk must contain the key string, on index v2 (council_evidence_index_v2.json)

probes.question: Which TCP port does the TRM council server listen on?
What is axiom A2 in the council's framework about?
How many modules does the TRM kernel have?
Which TCP port does the embedding server use?

gate_a_platform_facts.also_recorded_not_gating: the same four probes on v1 (shipped index), for the delta

gate_b_general_knowledge.status: out of scope for an evidence index
probes_that_failed_in_the_original_gate: does disabling TLS certificate verification allow machine-in-the-middle attacks?
why is an append-only hash chain tamper-evident?
gate_b_general_knowledge.where_it_is_measured_instead: the model: gpt-oss-20b 6/6 on general domains (docs/TRM_MoE_Inventory_Probe_2026-11-24.md)
gate_b_general_knowledge.no_run_here: Gate B is not run against the index again; a second 0/2 would only restate the original failure

next_if_gate_a_passes: Phase 1 opens: evidence_index.rs prefers v2, score floor re-derived from the v2 distribution, gate = every phoenix_evidence entry contains the text its verdict cites
next_if_gate_a_fails: the plan stops; v2 stays unwired and the facts stay available only on GET /platform/facts
